applicationStart: cd code_deploy_application && npm ci && NODE_ENV=production npm run build && { PORT=8080 nohup node static-server.js >> /root/application.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /root/application.pid; }
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill $(cat /root/application.pid) || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
